task1_tdc_install.outcome: PyTDC cannot be installed into the current system Python (Python 3.14, externally managed; an unrelated broken editable install causes ModuleNotFoundError in pip's build subprocess). PyTDC 1.1.15 is already installed in a separate Python 3.11 virtual environment. The split source code was read verbatim from that installation.

algorithm_verbatim.note_mol_vs_smiles_arg: TDC passes mol= (a Mol object), not smiles=; passing smiles= directly to MurckoScaffoldSmiles also works but TDC goes mol= route.
algorithm_verbatim.big_group_threshold: len(idx_set) > val_size/2 OR len(idx_set) > test_size/2 (with default frac=[0.7,0.1,0.2] and N=4200: threshold > 210)
algorithm_verbatim.ordering: 1. Partition into big/small. 2. random.shuffle(big, seed). 3. random.shuffle(small, seed). 4. Concatenate big + small. Tie-breaking is therefore by shuffle — NOT by scaffold SMILES or group size alone.
algorithm_verbatim.shuffle_rng: Python random.Random(seed) constructed, then random.seed(seed) called again before the first shuffle — as written in TDC source.
algorithm_verbatim.greedy_fill: For each group in order: if len(train)+size<=train_size => train; elif len(val)+size<=val_size => val; else test.

task2_canonical_split.description: TDC create_scaffold_split replicated exactly: same scaffold function, same big/small partition, same Random(42) shuffle, same greedy fill. Since Task 1 obtained TDC's algorithm, this IS the official TDC split.

specification.fill: greedy: train first (cap 2940), then val (cap 420), remainder to test

task4_sensitivity.verdict: ARM-A full-fold MAE ranges 0.0240–0.0488 (delta 0.0248, relative 103% of min). ARM-B coverage ranges 20.7–26.9pp (delta 6.2pp). Absolute MAE values are uniformly very low (<0.05), confirming high predictive quality under every convention. However the 2x relative variation in MAE and 6pp in coverage means the precise headline number DOES depend on tie-breaking choice. The paper should anchor to the TDC canonical (shuffle seed=42) and can defensibly claim that performance is strong under all conventions tested, but should NOT quote a single number without specifying the split convention.
task4_sensitivity.recommendation: Anchor all reported numbers to the TDC canonical split (seed=42). State results as 'under the TDC scaffold split with seed=42'. A robustness footnote can note that ARM-A full-fold MAE remains <0.05 under all four tie-break conventions tested, while acknowledging the precise value varies with split choice.

task1_mechanism_check.interpretation: Of 834 ARM-A covered test molecules, 834 have at least one activity in assay 1369278. Of those 834, the median of the assay-1369278-ONLY values equals the benchmark Y exactly (|err|<1e-9) for 834 — demonstrating label retrieval. By contrast, the pooled-median exact count (across all assays including external ones) is 689, lower because co-measured compounds get a diluted median.

task2_arm_b_assay_count.counting_definition: i — distinct assay_ids with at least one value for at least one COVERED test molecule (IK in ARM-B covered set)
task2_arm_b_assay_count.note_on_377: The 377 figure in the original run was fetched by querying all 4200 molecule InChIKeys (not just the 840 test molecules), because the sensitivity script fetched logd_all_b for the full dataset. The 377 is therefore the count across all 4200 molecules. The correct number for the paper — definition (i), distinct assays serving the 226 COVERED TEST molecules — is 122.
